sloka: तस्याहं लोकपालस्य वाक्यं तत्सुसमाहितः ।नैव जात्वनृतं कार्यमिति मे सौम्य दर्शनम् ।। ७.५०.१६ ॥
transliteration: tasyāhaṁ lokapālasya vākyaṁ tatsusamāhitaḥ ।naiva jātvanṛtaṁ kāryamiti me saumya darśanam ।। 7.50.16 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, I carefully consider that command of the protector of the world (Rama), for it is my view that one should never utter an untruth.
